x: We also held some Club handicaps, and these resulted as under:— 220 Yards Final—1, D.
Dicky Bartlett and D. Butler were second and third in the 220, and we also won the 2 miles team race, with Vern Blowfield leading the field home and scored yet another win in the 1 mile medley relay.

Gordon was 3rd, with Ron Morrell 5th in the Senior 100 and John Burr and Archie Bedford were 3rd and 4th in the 1 mile, which was won in 4 mins. 25 secs. by Brian Hewson, of Mitcham. Our team of Jim Heathfield, D. Butler, Ivan Mayers and Bob Wolton won the 1 mile medley relay, beating Mitcham, with Hercules third.
Key did well in the Long Jump, with D. Butler scoring points for us in the Weight.
Our lads also won the 4 x 110 yds. relay, and final match points were : Belgrave H., 33 ; South London H., 10. In the Senior events D.
